newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GITIC Enterprises IPO 892 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: GITIC Enterprises IPO 892 times subscribed.

text.p: GITIC Enterprises Ltd said in a statement on Sunday that its offer of 90 million shares to the public was 892 times subscribed.
All of the 10 million shares offered on a preferential basis to employees were also taken up.
The company offered a total of 100 million new shares at HK$1.05 each.
The issue was sponsored by Goldwyn Capital Ltd and ABN-AMRO Rothschild.
Dealing in the shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange is expected to start on March 26.
